hook: Cloud users can now use every one of IQM's 54 qubits at once.
sections: IQM entangled all 54 qubits on its Emerald chip in a single linked state.
Think of a rowing boat. Anyone can sync two rowers, but a long boat only flies when every oar enters the water together.
First, IQM links the qubits into one shared state. Second, it measures how faithful that state is against a 0.5 pass mark.
Before, many studies used just 10 to 20 qubits, and only about 30 here were reliably usable.
Now all 54 score 0.516 with readout correction, just above the threshold, and cloud users get the same full chip.
Real workloads need the whole chip. The margin is thin. IQM trades as IQMX. Our judgment: watch. Not financial advice.
